notes.title: The Trials 2 Demo is Out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999553/23ae0db9b31642daa3720848d373815b338cb524.jpg[/img]

In the Trials 2 demo, players are introduced to a slice of the game's expansive open world,
offering a glimpse of the challenges and mysteries that await. You start with one of four unique abilities.
Test your creativity and challenge your intelligence by using available mechanics to manipulate objects in real time to open new pathways,
and solve intricate puzzles. This demo teases a part of he full adventure,
which has more abilities and puzzles that will come in the complete game.
